Title: Microsoft Azure Load Testing supports setting up quick start tests using requests per second

Body.Content:
Quick test lets you quick start a load test without a JMeter script, enabling you to setup, run, and test your URL in less than 5 minutes in Azure Load Testing.

You can now set up a quick test to check if your endpoint can handle a certain throughput of requests. You can specify the target load in terms of Requests Per Second (RPS), provide the estimated response time and run the load test. 

Learn more here.
